column1: # A32-to-arm64 AOT text-size ratio per module, from the kit #6 game-AOT build's A32 objects ($SHEPHERD_WORK/kit6/kit-build/vb/
# k6-gaot-play/work/aot/<M>.dll.o, arm-vita-eabi-size .text) against this stage's arm64 full-AOT images (jit-work/mac/aot-full/<M>.dll.dylib,
# size -m __text). This sizes the DERIVED A32 projection of the arm64 JIT census (jitcensus.py): JIT code for the same methods, but JIT code
# avoids the AOT GOT-load and class-init sequences these module texts carry, so the module ratio is the UPPER bound and the gain lane's
# instruction-count ratio (1.23, jitstudy/gain.md section 4: 33 hot engine methods, insns x4) the LOWER bound. jitcensus.py default band: 1.23 / 1.4 / 1.6.
# weighted (by arm64 text): ~1.60 whole-module; the big two (CoreLib 1.64, Engine 1.51) dominate. JIT code should land below this
# (no GOT/class-init), so 1.4 is the central estimate and 1.6 the pessimistic cap.
